identity.mission: Elevate Ardito EIP from 'Sports Betting' to 'Enterprise Emotion Intelligence'. Fusion of Swiss Precision and Cinematic Sports Energy.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Bloomberg Terminal density with Nike commercial cinematography.
Emotion First: Data is the hero, but the feeling is 'Control' and 'Insight'.
Content is King: Every pixel serves the ROI story.
Zoom In: Focus on the data points that matter.

styles.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] text-white
styles.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-500

usage_rules.background: Use #02040A as the global background. Avoid pure black.
usage_rules.cards: Use Glassmorphism strategy. bg-white/5 with backdrop-blur-md and border-white/10.
usage_rules.text: Never use pure white for body text. Use #D1D5DB (gray-300) or #9CA3AF (gray-400).
usage_rules.brand: Use Primary Blue (#3B82F6) sparingly for CTAs and active states. Do not overuse.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to the background to kill digital flatness.

grids.hero: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center min-h-[80vh]

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/10

cards.feature: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-8 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors
cards.stat: flex flex-col p-6 rounded-xl bg-surface border border-white/5

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 border-b border-white/5 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60

hero_background.description: Massive stadium crowd at night, conveying scale and emotion. Apply heavy dark overlay.

enterprise_context.description: Corporate meeting room, serious tone, data analysis context.

motion.scroll_reveal: Use Framer Motion for 'whileInView' animations. Fade up with 20px y-offset.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette (Deep Night #02040A).
2. Refactor the Hero section to use the 'Stadium' image as a background with a gradient overlay.
3. Implement the 'Trust Signals' marquee immediately after the hero.
4. Redesign the 'Value Prop' section using the Bento Grid layout.
5. Ensure all text has proper contrast. Use the 'text-gray-300' for body text.
6. Use 'Chivo' font for all headings with 'tracking-tighter'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
